description: List the connected account's DAW sessions (most recently updated first) — their ids, names, DAW, and update time. Pages with limit + offset (the response carries total and next_offset); name_contains filters by name. Use a session id with doseedo_get_session and doseedo_edit_session; clean up old ones with doseedo_delete_sessions.

name_contains.description: Only sessions whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).

offset.description: How many to skip (default 0) — pass the previous response's next_offset to get the next page.

name: doseedo_list_sessions
